items.claim: Wes Schultz lacks power in his striking.
items.quote: He didn't have anything in the way of power

items.claim: Wes Schultz has the ability to mix in a variety of kicks to all levels.
items.quote: he does have really good ability to mix in a variety of kicks, and he can do it to all levels.

items.claim: Wes Schultz lacks physicality on his takedowns.
items.quote: the takedowns are uh they lack physicality

items.claim: Wes Schultz is very good at mat returning opponents once he has a hold of them.
items.quote: he can mat return the heck out of you if you do start getting up and he's got a hold of you.

items.claim: Wes Schultz is dangerous when he takes the back and attacks submissions.
items.quote: if he takes your back, you are in some serious trouble. He'll attack submissions.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has a strong Thai clinch utilizing knees and elbows.
items.quote: His tie clinch is his best thing. If he gets the tie clinch, he's just sending knees

items.claim: Jackson McVey does not defend takedowns well at all.
items.quote: He doesn't defend takedowns well at all.

items.claim: Jackson McVey starts fights really fast and fights in a kill-or-be-killed style.
items.quote: starts really fast. He's very kill or be killed.
